title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Using Trizol and RNAqueous Midi-Kit
author: Ambion
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4tjgwkn
materials: Force air through a few times again.
Move supernatant to a new tube.
Then incubate at Room temperature for 00:10:00 .

steps.title: Grind Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Quickly weigh out 3 g of frozen tissue and grind into a fine powder in a pre-chilled mortar containing liquid nitrogen, ensuring the sample does not thaw.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the powdered sample into a 50 ml centrifuge tube containing 30 mL of extraction buffer (10 ml buffer/g tissue).

substeps.instruction: Vortex for 00:01:00
Incubate at Room temperature for 00:05:00

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Add 6 mL of chloroform (2 ml chloroform/g tissue) and shake vigorously for at least 00:00:20.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:20:00 at 4 °C

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 50 ml tube and add one volume of isopropanol (approximately 22.5 mL) to precipitate RNA.

substeps.instruction: Invert gently several times
Incubate at Room temperature for 00:10:00
Centrifuge for 00:10:00 at 4 °C

steps.title: Wash and Dry Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 45 mL of 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Air dry the pellet for 00:05:00 (proceed even if not completely dry)

steps.title: Prepare for RNAqueous Midi-Kit
steps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet in 5 mL of lysis/binding Solution (use heating at 37 °C and vortexing to assist dissolution).

substeps.instruction: Heat 4.5 mL of elution solution to 100 °C for later use in a 17 X 100 mm round bottom sterile polypropylene tube with loose-fitting dual position cap

steps.title: Filter Lysate
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL of 64% ethanol to the RNA in lysis/binding solution.

substeps.instruction: Attach a filter unit and slowly push the lysate/ethanol mixture through (use multiple filters if the first becomes clogged)
Force air through using a clean 10 ml syringe until no more white foam is expelled (at least 3 or 4 times)

steps.title: Wash Filter
steps.instruction: Wash the filter using a syringe and a clean 18 g needle.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 100% volume of Wash Solution #1
Wash with 70% volume of Wash Solution #2/3; repeat this wash once
Force air through again until no more water droplets or fine spray are visible

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA at least 2 times into a 2 ml tube using 100 °C Elution Solution and a sterile 3 ml syringe.

substeps.instruction: Use only 500 µL at a time (elute three times per tube to obtain approximately 1.5 ml total)

steps.title: First LiCl Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform LiCl precipitation on each sample using the LiCl provided in the kit.

steps.title: Second LiCl Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform a second LiCl precipitation on the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Draw supernatant into a 10 ml syringe through an 18 gauge needle
Add 1/2 volume of LiCl
Place at -20 °C for at least 00:30:00
Centrifuge at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 00:15:00 at Room temperature
Wash pellet with 1 mL of 70% ethanol
Centrifuge again under the same conditions for 00:05:00
Remove supernatant and air dry pellet

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 50 µL or 100 µL RNase free H2O (heating and vortexing can be used to assist).

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the sample using the TURBO DNA-free kit from Ambion (AM1907).

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL of DNase and 0.1 volumes of 10X buffer
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:25:00
Add another 1.5 µL of DNase
Incubate at 37 °C for another 00:25:00

steps.title: Inactivate DNase
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 volumes of DNase Inactivation Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 00:05:00 at Room temperature, flicking tubes every minute
Centrifuge for 00:01:30

steps.title: Final Wash and Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform final cleanup of the sample.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:02:00 at 4 °C
Wash pellet with 45 mL of 70% ethanol
Centrifuge for 00:02:00 at 4 °C
